entities.name: Fall of the Primevals
entities.description: An event of Dominaria's Mythohistory in which the five Numena imprisoned the five Primevals.

entities.name: Primevals
entities.description: The five most powerful dragons: Crosis, Darigaaz, Dromar, Rith and Treva.

entities.name: Numena
entities.description: Five beings who plotted the Primevals' downfall and then ruled Dominaria for 1,000 years.

entities.name: Crosis
entities.description: Primeval dragon imprisoned in a tar pit catacomb in Urborg.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: Primeval dragon locked in a caldera in Shiv.

entities.name: Dromar
entities.description: Primeval dragon trapped in a cavern beneath the ocean.

entities.name: Rith
entities.description: Primeval dragon captured inside the Magnigoth Treefolk Nemata in Rith's Grove.

entities.name: Treva
entities.description: Primeval dragon lured into an ancient library in what became Argive and crucified.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: Numena who imprisoned Crosis; one of three survivors.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: Numena who imprisoned Darigaaz; one of three survivors.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: Numena who trapped Dromar with a vast treasure trove; one of three survivors.

entities.name: White Numena
entities.description: Numena who lured and crucified Treva.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: War after which dragons ruled Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane ruled by dragons then Numena.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Region that Rith's Grove later became part of.

events.summary: The five Numena plot against the Primevals and almost single-handedly imprison all five, one dragon each.
events.quote: the Numena managed to imprison the five Primevals, one dragon each

events.summary: Kuberr imprisons Crosis in a tar pit catacomb in Urborg, and Averru locks Darigaaz in a caldera in Shiv.
events.quote: Crosis was imprisoned in a tar pit catacomb in Urborg by the Numena Kuberr

events.summary: Lowallyn traps Dromar beneath the ocean with a treasure trove that sates every desire, leaving no reason to live.
events.quote: Dromar was trapped deep in a cavern beneath the ocean by the Numena Lowallyn

events.summary: The green Numena captures Rith inside the Magnigoth Treefolk Nemata.
events.quote: Rith was captured by the green Numena and put inside the Magnigoth Treefolk Nemata

events.summary: The white Numena lures Treva into an ancient library and crucifies her.
events.quote: Treva was lured into the depths of an ancient library

events.summary: The five Numena rule for 1,000 years until infighting kills two, leaving Kuberr, Lowallyn and Averru.
events.quote: the five Numena assumed control over the plane for 1,000 years

relations.quote: Crosis was imprisoned in a tar pit catacomb in Urborg by the Numena Kuberr
Darigaaz was locked into a caldera in Shiv by the Numena Averru
